name: Mood switch
what: A big round face changes mood - happy, calm, sad, wow - each change wipes a new background colour across the frame while the eyes and mouth morph, the face squashes and the mood's name drops in; a marker slides along a scale.

learned_from.what: a face changing mood with the background wiping to a new colour

motion: face back.out 16 f; each change: a circle wipe 16 f (slow end), the face morphs 12 f (S-curve) with a squash, the name drops, hold 24 f
